SEC-007.title: Approval Double-Spending Concurrency Hazard (CHALLENGED WITH COUNTEREVIDENCE)
SEC-007.defect_verification: CHALLENGED WITH COUNTEREVIDENCE: Finding SEC-007 claimed that EfApprovalRegistry.MarkConsumed lacks an optimistic concurrency token or row lock, allowing race-condition double spending. However, actual source code in src/Falah.Infrastructure/Persistence/FalahDbContext.cs line 183 explicitly configures 'b.Property(a => a.Consumed).IsConcurrencyToken();'. In EF Core, updating Consumed generates an UPDATE statement asserting WHERE [ApprovalId] = @p0 AND [Consumed] = 0. When two concurrent transactions race to consume the same approval, the second transaction matches 0 rows and EF Core throws DbUpdateConcurrencyException, rolling back the operation. While the race condition is mitigated by EF Core's concurrency token, migrating to a single atomic SQL command or row lock remains an architectural enhancement.

SEC-004.title: Shift Close Identity Spoofing via Unchecked ClosedByUserId
SEC-004.defect_verification: Verified in AuthenticationMiddleware.cs lines 86-90: closedByUserId is omitted from ActorFields. Any authenticated user can submit a CloseShiftRequest with any ClosedByUserId and close another cashier's shift without triggering actor mismatch.

SEC-005.title: Unguarded Read Access to Payroll Runs, Backups, Treasury, and Purchases
SEC-005.defect_verification: Verified in Program.cs: 67 GET endpoints require a valid session token but enforce zero permission checks, exposing internal financial confidentiality.

SEC-008.title: Session Token Replacement & Identity Confusion in PIN Replay Proof
SEC-008.defect_verification: Verified in UsersViewModel.Actions.cs lines 167-172: Replay proof calls ApiClient.LoginByPinAsync(original.NewPin), which unconditionally overwrites ApiClient._sessionToken and HTTP Authorization header, corrupting the ambient till session.

SEC-009.title: PIN Uniqueness Check-Then-Act Race Condition
SEC-009.defect_verification: Verified in PinUniquenessChecker.cs lines 18-23: Reads active users with AsNoTracking() without table or row lock. Concurrent creates or PIN changes can assign the same PIN to two distinct accounts.

SEC-010.title: High PBKDF2 Computational Cost on PIN Uniqueness Validation
SEC-010.defect_verification: Verified in PinUniquenessChecker.cs lines 20-22: Executes 210,000 PBKDF2-SHA256 iterations sequentially for every active user in LINQ .Any(). 50 users require 10.5M iterations, tying up CPU cores.

SEC-011.title: User Reactivation Missing PIN Uniqueness Verification
SEC-011.defect_verification: Verified in SetUserActiveHandler.cs lines 62-68: Sets target.Active = true without calling PinUniquenessChecker. If another user claimed that PIN while deactivated, two active users now share the same PIN.

SEC-012.title: User Deactivation Omits Explicit Session Token Revocation
SEC-012.defect_verification: Verified in SetUserActiveHandler.cs lines 62-68: Sets target.Active = false but leaves records in UserSessions unrevoked. Mitigated dynamically by SessionService.ResolveAsync checking user.Active, but sessions revive if user is reactivated.

FIN-MULTI-ELEC-001.title: Split Payment Electronic Split Ceiling Restriction
FIN-MULTI-ELEC-001.defect_verification: Verified in CheckoutRules.cs line 60: SelectElectronicLeg executes splitPayments.First(p => p.Method is PaymentMethod.InstaPay or PaymentMethod.Wallet). Drops secondary electronic legs when customer splits across multiple electronic methods.

INV-PERF-001.title: In-Memory Full Table Pull on StockMovements in ListInventoryItemsAsync
INV-PERF-001.defect_verification: Verified in InventoryQueryService.cs lines 23-26: Queries entire StockMovements table into memory via ToListAsync(ct), then performs client-side GroupBy in LINQ-to-Objects.

INV-SYNC-001.title: Inventory Deduction / Order Refund Restock Synchronization Gap
INV-SYNC-001.defect_verification: Verified in InventoryDeductionService.cs (which adds usage movements on checkout) vs RefundOrderHandler.cs (which creates financial refund and treasury movement, but zero stock restock movements).

INV-FIN-001.title: Uncosted Waste Coercion to Zero in Loss Summary
INV-FIN-001.defect_verification: Verified in InventoryQueryService.cs lines 63-64: Uses m.LossValuePiastres ?? 0 in Sum(), silently reporting 0 EGP loss for uncosted items without an unknown loss count flag.
